narration.full_text: Namaste students! Today, we're going to explore the graphical method for solving pairs of linear equations. This visual approach will help us understand the different types of solutions we can encounter. By the end of this section, you'll be able to explain the graphical method for solving linear equations, distinguish between intersecting, parallel, and coincident lines, relate these graphical outcomes to consistent, inconsistent, and dependent systems, and finally, solve pairs of linear equations by plotting graphs and identifying intersection points.
